literature.headline_zh: 基孔肯雅病毒本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期基孔肯雅病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: QHTD组在所有主要终点指标上均表现出统计学上的显著优势:第3天总体治疗反应率显著提高,第3天和第7天中医证候评分平均下降幅度更大(所有P < 0.05),发热、关节痛和皮疹的缓解率更高且缓解时间更短,3个月随访时不良反应和关节痛后遗症的发病率更低。 [10.21203/rs.3.rs-11148288/v1]
我们的高分辨率研究识别了与埃及伊蚊数量和基孔肯雅热传播风险相关的微尺度脆弱性。 [10.1371/journal.pntd.0014776]
纯化的CHIKV颗粒在所有储存条件下均表现出70.4%的回收率,并且病毒颗粒形态得以保留。然而,感染力随时间逐渐下降,且在所测试的方案中未观察到显著差异。 [10.21203/rs.3.rs-11183026/v1]
17只猕猴(42.5%)检测到中和抗体,其中16只(40.0%)检测到针对DENV的中和抗体,1只(2.5%)检测到针对CHIKV的中和抗体。检测到针对DENV-1、DENV-2和DENV-3的中和抗体,但未检测到针对DENV-4、ZIKV和JEV的抗体。所有样本中均未发现病毒RNA。 [10.1186/s41182-026-01089-0]
TR对CHIKV的IC50估计为Vero细胞中20.05 μM,C2C12细胞中19.71 μM。此外,TR通过减少病毒载量保护C57BL/6小鼠免受CHIKV挑战,从而降低了临床评分并提高了存活率。 [10.1128/jvi.00558-26]
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 本期研究方向以入选文献实际覆盖的临床、流行病学、宿主生态、诊断或分子监测主题为准。
literature.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.
key_findings_en: The QHTD group exhibited statistically superior outcomes across all primary endpoints: significantly higher overall treatment response rate on Day 3, greater mean reductions in TCM syndrome scores on Days 3 and 7 (all P < 0.05), faster resolution rates and shorter resolution times for fever, arthralgia, and rash, and lower incidence of adverse reactions and arthralgia sequelae at the 3-month follow-up. [10.21203/rs.3.rs-11148288/v1]
Our high-resolution study identified fine-scale vulnerabilities linked to both Aedes aegypti abundance and heightened risk of CHIKV transmission. [10.1371/journal.pntd.0014776]

Purified CHIKV particles showed a 70.4% recovery rate and preserved virion morphology across all storage conditions. However, infectivity declined progressively over time, with no significant differences observed among the tested protocols. [10.21203/rs.3.rs-11183026/v1]

Seventeen macaques (42.5%) had neutralizing antibodies, with 16 (40.0%) showing antibodies against DENV and one (2.5%) against CHIKV. Neutralizing antibodies against DENV-1, DENV-2, and DENV-3 were detected, whereas DENV-4, ZIKV, and JEV antibodies were not detected. No viral RNA was identified in any sample. [10.1186/s41182-026-01089-0]

The IC50 of TR against CHIKV was estimated to be 20.05 μM and 19.71 μM in Vero and C2C12 cells, respectively. Additionally, TR protected C57BL/6 mice from CHIKV challenge by diminishing viral burden, leading to reduced clinical scores and better survival. [10.1128/jvi.00558-26]

The QHTD group exhibited statistically superior outcomes across all primary endpoints: significantly higher overall treatment response rate on Day 3, greater mean reductions in TCM syndrome scores on Days 3 and 7 (all P < 0.05), faster resolution rates and shorter resolution times for fever, arthralgia, and rash, and lower incidence of adverse reactions and arthralgia sequelae at the 3-month follow-up. key_findings_zh: 一项高分辨率研究通过分析蚊虫繁殖模式和人类血清阳性率,绘制了巴西贫民窟中基孔肯雅病毒的风险地图,揭示了社会经济和环境因素如何影响传播。 [news-dbf23d2f657f1a60]
由廖宇华及其同事发表在《PLOS Pathogens》上的一项新研究分析了三种东/中/南非(ECSA)基因型基孔肯雅病毒亚谱系的分子进化,揭示了针对不同蚊媒媒介的适应性策略。 [news-aa0ce7def68004c3]
文章讨论了由于依赖临床病例检测,东非地区检测基孔肯雅热暴发的挑战,这会导致延迟。它指出基孔肯雅热传播模式已从森林型向城市型转变,涉及埃及伊蚊。 [news-d8f5e1ba25b5a0c8]
香港卫生防护中心(CHP)在持续的蚊虫繁殖季期间警告登革热(DF)和基孔肯雅热(CF)的风险。CHP记录显示,2026年10月2日至10月9日期间发现一例输入性登革热病例和一例输入性基孔肯雅热病例。该基孔肯雅热患者在潜伏期内曾前往中国大陆,并在旅行期间感染。 [news-3262e6d624f1080e]
据雅虎财经报道,英国撤销了对Ixchiq寨卡病毒疫苗的批准。该决定是基于英国人类药物委员会对之前可获得的安全信息进行评估作出的。 [news-89bcf684dde5e02f]
news.trend_or_risk_zh: 风险判断仅依据入选来源已经确认的信息，不把媒体推测升级为官方结论。
news.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following Chikungunya virus news developments.
key_findings_en: A high-resolution study mapped chikungunya virus risk in a Brazilian slum by analyzing mosquito breeding patterns and human seropositivity, revealing how socioeconomic and environmental factors influence transmission. [news-dbf23d2f657f1a60]

A new study published in PLOS Pathogens by Yuhua Liao and colleagues analyzed the molecular evolution of three sub-lineages of the East/Central/South African (ECSA) genotype of Chikungunya virus, revealing distinct adaptive strategies for different mosquito vectors. [news-aa0ce7def68004c3]

The article discusses the challenges of detecting chikungunya outbreaks in East Africa due to reliance on clinical case detection, which introduces delays. It highlights the shift in transmission patterns from sylvatic spillover to urban cycles involving Aedes mosquitoes. [news-d8f5e1ba25b5a0c8]

The Centre for Health Protection (CHP) warned of dengue fever (DF) and chikungunya fever (CF) risks during the ongoing mosquito breeding season. The CHP recorded one imported DF case and one imported CF case from October 2 to October 9, 2026. [news-3262e6d624f1080e]

The UK withdrew approval for the Ixchiq chikungunya vaccine, as reported by Yahoo Finance. The decision was based on an assessment by the UK's Commission on Human Medicines using previously available safety information. [news-89bcf684dde5e02f]

papers.title: Nanopore Sequencing for Chikungunya Virus: Principles and Application.
papers.abstract: Nanopore sequencing is transforming viral genomics through real-time, portable, long-read analysis of RNA and DNA. Unlike traditional short-read platforms, it detects nucleotide sequences by measuring ionic current changes as nucleic acids pass through nanoscale pores, enabling direct single-molecule sequencing and base modification detection. Its simplicity, flexibility, and capacity for ultra-long reads make it ideal for resolving complex genomic regions, structural variants, and full viral genomes. These advantages have accelerated its use in pathogen surveillance and outbreak response, especially in resource-limited settings. For chikungunya virus (CHIKV), nanopore sequencing allows rapid, culture-independent recovery of complete genomes from clinical and vector samples, enabling real-time tracking of viral diversity, evolution, and spread. Experiences from Ebola, Zika, and COVID-19 have demonstrated the power of portable sequencing, now applied to CHIKV monitoring. Advances in tools such as Guppy, Dorado, Minimap2, and Medaka enhance read quality, consensus accuracy, and downstream analyses. Despite challenges in basecalling and error correction, robust quality control pipelines ensure reliable results. Ongoing improvements in chemistry, flow cell design, and machine learning will further enhance fidelity and throughput, establishing nanopore sequencing as a cornerstone of CHIKV genomic surveillance and epidemic preparedness.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to explore the application of nanopore sequencing in Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) genomics, addressing the need for rapid, portable, and accurate methods to track viral diversity and evolution during outbreaks.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study focused on the principles and application of nanopore sequencing for Chikungunya virus, examining its use in clinical and vector samples to recover complete genomes and monitor viral spread.
analysis.methods: Nanopore sequencing was used to directly sequence RNA and DNA by measuring ionic current changes as nucleic acids pass through nanoscale pores, enabling real-time, single-molecule analysis of Chikungunya virus genomes without the need for culture.
analysis.main_results: The method demonstrated the ability to rapidly recover full viral genomes from clinical and vector samples, facilitating real-time tracking of viral diversity, evolution, and spread during outbreaks.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted these findings as a significant advancement in pathogen surveillance, particularly for resource-limited settings, where nanopore sequencing provides a flexible and powerful tool for monitoring Chikungunya virus.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform the development of more effective genomic surveillance strategies for Chikungunya virus, enhancing outbreak response and epidemic preparedness.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study acknowledges challenges in basecalling and error correction but highlights robust quality control pipelines that ensure reliable results, supporting a moderate confidence in the evidence.

analysis.summary_en: This study explores the application of nanopore sequencing in Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) genomics, emphasizing its advantages in real-time, portable, and long-read analysis. The research highlights how nanopore sequencing enables rapid, culture-independent recovery of complete CHIKV genomes from clinical and vector samples, facilitating real-time tracking of viral diversity and spread. The authors interpret these findings as a significant advancement in pathogen surveillance, particularly for resource-limited settings, where the method offers flexibility and power. The study notes challenges in basecalling and error correction but underscores the reliability of quality control pipelines. These results have implications for improving genomic surveillance and epidemic preparedness for CHIKV. The evidence is considered moderate in strength due to the acknowledged limitations in the sequencing process, though the method's potential is well-supported by prior experiences with other pathogens.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨纳米孔测序在基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV)基因组学中的应用,以应对在疫情期间快速、便携和准确追踪病毒多样性及传播的迫切需求。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究聚焦于纳米孔测序在基孔肯雅病毒中的原理与应用,考察其在临床和环境样本中用于恢复完整病毒基因组和监测病毒传播的使用情况。
elements_zh.methods: 纳米孔测序通过测量核酸穿过纳米级孔时的离子电流变化,直接对RNA和DNA进行测序,从而实现对基孔肯雅病毒基因组的实时、单分子分析,无需依赖培养。
elements_zh.main_results: 该方法展示了从临床和环境样本中快速恢复完整病毒基因组的能力,有助于在疫情期间实时追踪病毒多样性、传播及扩散。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为病原体监测领域的重要进展,特别是在资源有限的环境中,纳米孔测序提供了一种灵活且强大的工具,用于基孔肯雅病毒的监测。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为基孔肯雅病毒的更有效监测策略的制定提供依据,从而增强疫情响应和疫情应对能力。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究承认在碱基调用和错误校正方面存在挑战,但强调了稳健的质量控制流程,确保了可靠的结果,支持了中等程度的证据可信度。

papers.title: Overview of Chikungunya Virus Epidemiology, Biology, and Pathogenesis.
papers.abstract: Chikungunya virus (CHIKV), an arthropod-borne alphavirus within the Togaviridae family, is transmitted primarily by Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus. The virus causes an acute febrile illness characterized by severe, often bilateral polyarthralgia, with potential progression to chronic musculoskeletal pain and rare systemic complications involving cardiovascular and neurological systems. CHIKV exhibits a spherical, enveloped virion (~70 nm) with T = 4 icosahedral symmetry, incorporating E1/E2 glycoprotein heterodimers that mediate receptor binding and membrane fusion. Its positive-sense RNA genome (~11.8 kb) encodes nonstructural proteins for replication and structural proteins for virion assembly. Replication occurs in cytoplasmic spherules, involving synthesis of genomic and subgenomic RNAs, followed by glycoprotein maturation and budding at the plasma membrane. Epidemiologically, CHIKV has expanded beyond Africa and Asia, with major outbreaks driven by adaptive mutations enhancing transmission via A. Since introduction to the Americas in 2013, the global incidence remains high, with >180,000 confirmed cases reported in 2025. Preventive strategies rely on vector control and vaccination; VLP-based vaccines (e.g., Vimkunya) show promise, while live-attenuated formulations face safety concerns. No licensed antivirals exist; current management is supportive, though investigational therapies targeting viral replication and immune modulation are under development.

analysis.summary_en: This study provides an overview of Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) epidemiology, biology, and pathogenesis. It describes the virus as an arthropod-borne alphavirus transmitted primarily by Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus, causing acute febrile illness with severe polyarthralgia and potential chronic complications. The virus has a spherical, enveloped virion with T = 4 icosahedral symmetry and a positive-sense RNA genome encoding replication and structural proteins. CHIKV replication occurs in cytoplasmic spherules, involving genomic and subgenomic RNA synthesis, glycoprotein maturation, and budding at the plasma membrane. Since its introduction to the Americas in 2013, the global incidence has remained high, with over 180,000 confirmed cases in 2025. The study highlights the expansion of CHIKV beyond Africa and Asia, driven by adaptive mutations that enhance transmission. Preventive strategies rely on vector control and vaccination, with VLP-based vaccines showing promise and live-attenuated formulations facing safety concerns. No licensed antivirals exist, and current management is supportive, though investigational therapies targeting viral replication and immune modulation are under development. The evidence is general and does not include specific limitations or evidence strength assessments.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV),一种属于Togaviridae科的虫媒α病毒,主要通过埃及伊蚊(Aedes aegypti)和白纹伊蚊(Aedes albopictus)传播。该病毒引起一种急性发热性疾病,特征为严重的、常为双侧性关节痛,可能进展为慢性肌肉骨骼疼痛,并偶有涉及心血管和神经系统系统的全身并发症。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究概述了基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV)的结构、生物学及系统发育。研究内容包括病毒的结构、复制机制及其全球传播情况。分析涵盖了CHIKV谱系及其相关疾病。
elements_zh.methods: 基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV)具有球形、包膜的病毒颗粒(约70 nm),呈T = 4二十面体对称结构,包含介导受体结合和膜融合的E1/E2糖蛋白异二聚体。其正链RNA基因组(约11.8 kb)编码用于复制的非结构蛋白和用于病毒颗粒组装的结构蛋白。病毒复制发生在细胞质囊泡中,涉及基因组和亚基因组RNA的合成,随后是糖蛋白成熟和在细胞膜上出芽。
elements_zh.main_results: 自2013年引入美洲以来,全球发病率仍保持较高水平,2025年报告了超过180,000例确诊病例。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 从流行病学角度看,CHIKV已扩展至非洲和亚洲以外的地区,其主要传播模式由适应性进化增强其传播能力。预防策略依赖于媒介控制和疫苗接种;基于病毒样颗粒(VLP)的疫苗(如Vimkunya)显示出前景,而减毒活疫苗则面临安全性问题。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 目前尚无获批的抗病毒药物;现有管理措施为支持性治疗,但针对病毒复制和免疫调节的试验性疗法正在研发中。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 提供的证据未报告局限性或证据强度。

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: Chikungunya virus (CHIKV), an arthropod-borne alphavirus within the Togaviridae family, is transmitted primarily by Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus. The virus causes an acute febrile illness characterized by severe, often bilateral polyarthralgia, with potential progression to chronic musculoskeletal pain and rare systemic complications involving cardiovascular and neurological systems.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: The study provides an overview of Chikungunya virus epidemiology, biology, and pathogenesis. It includes information on the virus's structure, replication mechanisms, and its global spread. The analysis covers CHIKV lineages and their associated diseases.
analysis_en.methods: CHIKV exhibits a spherical, enveloped virion (~70 nm) with T = 4 icosahedral symmetry, incorporating E1/E2 glycoprotein heterodimers that mediate receptor binding and membrane fusion. Its positive-sense RNA genome (~11.8 kb) encodes nonstructural proteins for replication and structural proteins for virion assembly. Replication occurs in cytoplasmic spherules, involving synthesis of genomic and subgenomic RNAs, followed by glycoprotein maturation and budding at the plasma membrane.
analysis_en.main_results: Since introduction to the Americas in 2013, the global incidence remains high, with >180,000 confirmed cases reported in 2025.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: Epidemiologically, CHIKV has expanded beyond Africa and Asia, with major outbreaks driven by adaptive mutations enhancing transmission via A. Preventive strategies rely on vector control and vaccination; VLP-based vaccines (e.g., Vimkunya) show promise, while live-attenuated formulations face safety concerns.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: No licensed antivirals exist; current management is supportive, though investigational therapies targeting viral replication and immune modulation are under development.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The supplied evidence does not report limitations or evidence strength.

papers.title_zh: 基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV)概述、生物学及系统发育
papers.source_body_en: Chikungunya virus (CHIKV), an arthropod-borne alphavirus within the Togaviridae family, is transmitted primarily by Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus. The virus causes an acute febrile illness characterized by severe, often bilateral polyarthralgia, with potential progression to chronic musculoskeletal pain and rare systemic complications involving cardiovascular and neurological systems. CHIKV exhibits a spherical, enveloped virion (~70 nm) with T = 4 icosahedral symmetry, incorporating E1/E2 glycoprotein heterodimers that mediate receptor binding and membrane fusion. Its positive-sense RNA genome (~11.8 kb) encodes nonstructural proteins for replication and structural proteins for virion assembly. Replication occurs in cytoplasmic spherules, involving synthesis of genomic and subgenomic RNAs, followed by glycoprotein maturation and budding at the plasma membrane. Epidemiologically, CHIKV has expanded beyond Africa and Asia, with major outbreaks driven by adaptive mutations enhancing transmission via A. Since introduction to the Americas in 2013, the global incidence remains high, with >180,000 confirmed cases reported in 2025. Preventive strategies rely on vector control and vaccination; VLP-based vaccines (e.g., Vimkunya) show promise, while live-attenuated formulations face safety concerns. No licensed antivirals exist; current management is supportive, though investigational therapies targeting viral replication and immune modulation are under development.
papers.abstract_zh: 基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV),一种属于Togaviridae科的虫媒α病毒,主要通过埃及伊蚊(Aedes aegypti)和白纹伊蚊(Aedes albopictus)传播。该病毒引起一种急性发热性疾病,特征为严重的、常为双侧性关节痛,可能进展为慢性肌肉骨骼疼痛,并偶有涉及心血管和神经系统系统的全身并发症。CHIKV具有球形、包膜的病毒颗粒(约70 nm),呈T = 4二十面体对称结构,包含介导受体结合和膜融合的E1/E2糖蛋白异二聚体。其正链RNA基因组(约11.8 kb)编码用于复制的非结构蛋白和用于病毒颗粒组装的结构蛋白。病毒复制发生在细胞质囊泡中,涉及基因组和亚基因组RNA的合成,随后是糖蛋白成熟和在细胞膜上出芽。从流行病学角度看,CHIKV已扩展至非洲和亚洲以外的地区,其主要传播模式由适应性进化增强其传播能力。自2013年引入美洲以来,全球发病率仍保持较高水平,2025年报告了超过180,000例确诊病例。预防策略依赖于媒介控制和疫苗接种;基于病毒样颗粒(VLP)的疫苗(如Vimkunya)显示出前景,而减毒活疫苗则面临安全性问题。目前尚无获批的抗病毒药物;现有管理措施为支持性治疗,但针对病毒复制和免疫调节的试验性疗法正在研发中。

papers.title: Neutralizing antibody evidence of dengue and chikungunya virus exposure in macaques from an urban–forest fringe in Peninsular Malaysia
papers.abstract: Arboviruses such as dengue virus (DENV), chikungunya virus (CHIKV), Zika virus (ZIKV), and Japanese encephalitis virus (JEV) circulate between mosquito vectors and vertebrate hosts, with non-human primates (NHPs) playing an important role in sylvatic transmission cycles. In Malaysia, frequent interactions between long-tailed macaques (Macaca fascicularis) and humans at the Universiti Kebangsaan Malaysia (UKM) Bangi campus provide an opportunity to investigate arbovirus exposure at the human–wildlife interface. Forty free-ranging macaques were sampled from five locations within the UKM Bangi campus. Serum samples were screened for neutralizing antibodies against DENV, CHIKV, ZIKV, and JEV using the 90% focus reduction neutralization test (FRNT 90 ), while whole blood was tested for viral RNA by RT–qPCR. Seventeen macaques (42.5%) had neutralizing antibodies, indicating previous arbovirus exposure. Specifically, 16 (40.0%) had neutralizing antibodies against DENV and one (2.5%) against CHIKV. Neutralizing antibodies against DENV-1, DENV-2, and DENV-3 were detected, whereas DENV-4, ZIKV, and JEV antibodies were not detected. No viral RNA was identified in any sample. To our knowledge, this is the first study in Malaysia to investigate arbovirus exposure in free-ranging macaques using FRNT 90 neutralizing antibody assays. These findings provide updated evidence of DENV and CHIKV exposure in macaques at the human–wildlife interface and highlight the need for integrated longitudinal surveillance of NHPs, mosquito vectors, and humans to better understand arbovirus ecology and transmission dynamics.

analysis.study_design_and_population: Forty free-ranging macaques were sampled from five locations within the Universiti Kebangsaan Malaysia (UKM) Bangi campus, where frequent interactions between macaques and humans occur.
analysis.methods: Serum samples were screened for neutralizing antibodies against dengue virus (DENV), chikungunya virus (CHIKV), Zika virus (ZIKV), and Japanese encephalitis virus (JEV) using the 90% focus reduction neutralization test (FRNT 90), while whole blood was tested for viral RNA by RT–qPCR.
analysis.main_results: Seventeen macaques (42.5%) had neutralizing antibodies, with 16 (40.0%) showing antibodies against DENV and one (2.5%) against CHIKV. analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings contribute to understanding the ecology and transmission dynamics of arboviruses at the human–wildlife interface, emphasizing the need for integrated surveillance of macaques, mosquito vectors, and humans.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its cross-sectional design and the absence of longitudinal data, which may affect the generalizability of the findings. The evidence is moderate as it is based on antibody detection rather than direct viral isolation.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated arbovirus exposure in free-ranging macaques at the Universiti Kebangsaan Malaysia Bangi campus, focusing on dengue and chikungunya viruses. Serum samples were tested for neutralizing antibodies using FRNT 90, and whole blood was analyzed for viral RNA via RT–qPCR. Results showed that 42.5% of the macaques had neutralizing antibodies, with 40.0% against dengue and 2.5% against chikungunya. Antibodies were detected against DENV-1, DENV-2, and DENV-3, but not DENV-4, ZIKV, or JEV. No viral RNA was found in any sample. The study highlights the role of macaques in arbovirus transmission and underscores the need for integrated surveillance. However, the cross-sectional design limits the depth of understanding, and the evidence is considered moderate due to reliance on antibody detection.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨人类—野生动物界面的虫媒病毒暴露情况,特别是关注非人灵长类动物在登革病毒和基孔肯雅病毒等虫媒病毒丛林型传播循环中的作用。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 从马来西亚国家大学(UKM)班金分校校园内的五个地点采集了40只自由活动的猕猴样本,该校园是猕猴与人类频繁互动的区域。
elements_zh.methods: 使用90%焦点减少中和试验(FRNT 90)检测血清样本中针对登革病毒(DENV)、基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV)、寨卡病毒(ZIKV)和日本脑炎病毒(JEV)的中和抗体,同时用RT–qPCR检测全血中的病毒RNA。
elements_zh.main_results: 17只猕猴(42.5%)检测到中和抗体,其中16只(40.0%)检测到针对DENV的中和抗体,1只(2.5%)检测到针对CHIKV的中和抗体。检测到针对DENV-1、DENV-2和DENV-3的中和抗体,但未检测到针对DENV-4、ZIKV和JEV的抗体。所有样本中均未发现病毒RNA。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 本研究首次在马来西亚使用FRNT 90中和抗体检测方法,提供了自由活动猕猴暴露于虫媒病毒的证据,突显了这些动物在DENV和CHIKV虫媒病毒传播动态中的重要性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现有助于理解虫媒病毒在人类—野生动物界面的生态学和传播动态,强调了对猕猴、蚊虫媒介和人类进行整合监测的必要性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究受限于横断面设计和缺乏纵向数据,这可能影响研究结果的普遍适用性。由于基于抗体检测而非直接病毒分离,证据强度中等。

papers.abstract_zh: 登革病毒(DENV)、基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV)、寨卡病毒(ZIKV)和日本脑炎病毒(JEV)等虫媒病毒在蚊虫媒介和脊椎动物宿主之间循环传播,而非人灵长类动物(NHPs)在丛林型传播循环中起着重要作用。在马来西亚,长尾猕猴(Macaca fascicularis)与人类在马来西亚国家大学(UKM)班金分校校园内的频繁互动,为研究人类—野生动物界面的虫媒病毒暴露提供了机会。从UKM班金分校校园内的五个地点采集了40只自由活动的猕猴血清样本。使用90%焦点减少中和试验(FRNT 90)检测血清样本中针对DENV、CHIKV、ZIKV和JEV的中和抗体,同时用RT–qPCR检测全血中的病毒RNA。17只猕猴(42.5%)检测到中和抗体,表明其曾暴露于虫媒病毒。具体而言,16只(40.0%)检测到针对DENV的中和抗体,1只(2.5%)检测到针对CHIKV的中和抗体。检测到针对DENV-1、DENV-2和DENV-3的中和抗体,但未检测到针对DENV-4、ZIKV和JEV的抗体。所有样本中均未发现病毒RNA。据我们所知,这是马来西亚首次使用FRNT 90中和抗体检测方法研究自由活动猕猴的虫媒病毒暴露。这些发现为马来西亚猕猴在人类—野生动物界面的DENV和CHIKV暴露提供了新的证据,并强调了对猕猴、蚊虫媒介和人类进行整合的纵向监测研究的必要性,以更好地理解虫媒病毒生态学和传播动态。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨人类—野生动物界面的虫媒病毒暴露情况,特别是关注非人灵长类动物在登革病毒和基孔肯雅病毒等虫媒病毒丛林型传播循环中的作用。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 从马来西亚国家大学(UKM)班金分校校园内的五个地点采集了40只自由活动的猕猴样本,该校园是猕猴与人类频繁互动的区域。
analysis_zh.methods: 使用90%焦点减少中和试验(FRNT 90)检测血清样本中针对登革病毒(DENV)、基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV)、寨卡病毒(ZIKV)和日本脑炎病毒(JEV)的中和抗体,同时用RT–qPCR检测全血中的病毒RNA。
analysis_zh.main_results: 17只猕猴(42.5%)检测到中和抗体,其中16只(40.0%)检测到针对DENV的中和抗体,1只(2.5%)检测到针对CHIKV的中和抗体。检测到针对DENV-1、DENV-2和DENV-3的中和抗体,但未检测到针对DENV-4、ZIKV和JEV的抗体。所有样本中均未发现病毒RNA。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 本研究首次在马来西亚使用FRNT 90中和抗体检测方法,提供了自由活动猕猴暴露于虫媒病毒的证据,突显了这些动物在DENV和CHIKV虫媒病毒传播动态中的重要性。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现有助于理解虫媒病毒在人类—野生动物界面的生态学和传播动态,强调了对猕猴、蚊虫媒介和人类进行整合监测的必要性。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究受限于横断面设计和缺乏纵向数据,这可能影响研究结果的普遍适用性。由于基于抗体检测而非直接病毒分离,证据强度中等。

papers.title: Repurposing tretinoin, a vitamin A derivative, against Chikungunya virus infection
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) has reemerged as a global pathogen causing serious public health threat, particularly due to the absence of specific antivirals. Retinoids, vitamin A derivatives, have demonstrated antiviral potential against different viral infections, yet their efficacy against alphaviruses has never been investigated. In this study, tretinoin (TR), or all-trans retinoic acid (ATRA), was evaluated for its anti-CHIKV activity using in vitro , in vivo , and ex vivo models. TR abrogated CHIKV infection efficiently in Vero and C2C12 cells, with a marked reduction (>90%) in viral RNA, proteins, and progeny formation. The IC 50 of TR against CHIKV was estimated to be 20.05 μM and 19.71 μM in Vero and C2C12 cells, respectively. Additionally, TR showed remarkable virucidal activity and effective inhibition during entry, as well as in the early stages of post-CHIKV infection. Next, the global transcriptome profile demonstrated that the “signaling by retinoic acid” pathway was significantly enriched after CHIKV infection, and retinoic acid receptors (RARs), specifically RAR-β, are the key mediators for the anti-CHIKV effect of TR. Further, the drug alters phosphorylated mitogen-activated protein kinases (MAPKs), NF-κB, and proinflammatory cytokines during CHIKV infection in RAW 264.7 cells. Interestingly, TR protected C57BL/6 mice from CHIKV challenge by diminishing viral burden, leading to reduced clinical scores and better survival. Similar observations were also noticed in the ex vivo models of CHIKV-infected primary human skeletal muscle myoblasts (HSMMs). In conclusion, this work demonstrated the repurposing potential of TR against CHIKV infection for the first time, encouraging its clinical validation toward future therapeutics. IMPORTANCE Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) is an arbovirus causing Chikungunya fever (CHIKF), leading to debilitating arthralgia and myalgia. The unavailability of licensed antivirals against CHIKV encourages extensive research to find a therapeutic cure. Retinoids, the derivatives of vitamin A, have been repurposed as antiviral agents against a broad range of viruses; however, their potency against alphaviruses remains unexplored. Accordingly, tretinoin (TR), also known as all-trans retinoic acid (ATRA), was validated for anti-CHIKV efficacy in this investigation. Significant perturbations of CHIKV titer, RNA, and protein levels were observed in the presence of TR following infection, and its antiviral effect was mediated through RAR-β. Moreover, the anti-CHIKV potential of TR was evaluated in the mouse model and primary human skeletal muscle myoblasts, indicating strong preclinical efficacy. Finally, this is the first study to report the antiviral property of TR against CHIKV infection using in vitro , in vivo , and ex vivo approaches, suggesting its repurposing potential.

papers.title_zh: 利用维甲酸衍生物三氧化二砷对抗基孔肯雅病毒感染
papers.source_body_en: ABSTRACT Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) has reemerged as a global pathogen causing serious public health threat, particularly due to the absence of specific antivirals. Retinoids, vitamin A derivatives, have demonstrated antiviral potential against different viral infections, yet their efficacy against alphaviruses has never been investigated. In this study, tretinoin (TR), or all-trans retinoic acid (ATRA), was evaluated for its anti-CHIKV activity using in vitro , in vivo , and ex vivo models. TR abrogated CHIKV infection efficiently in Vero and C2C12 cells, with a marked reduction (>90%) in viral RNA, proteins, and progeny formation. The IC 50 of TR against CHIKV was estimated to be 20.05 μM and 19.71 μM in Vero and C2C12 cells, respectively. Additionally, TR showed remarkable virucidal activity and effective inhibition during entry, as well as in the early stages of post-CHIKV infection. Next, the global transcriptome profile demonstrated that the “signaling by retinoic acid” pathway was significantly enriched after CHIKV infection, and retinoic acid receptors (RARs), specifically RAR-β, are the key mediators for the anti-CHIKV effect of TR. Further, the drug alters phosphorylated mitogen-activated protein kinases (MAPKs), NF-κB, and proinflammatory cytokines during CHIKV infection in RAW 264.7 cells. Interestingly, TR protected C57BL/6 mice from CHIKV challenge by diminishing viral burden, leading to reduced clinical scores and better survival. Similar observations were also noticed in the ex vivo models of CHIKV-infected primary human skeletal muscle myoblasts (HSMMs). In conclusion, this work demonstrated the repurposing potential of TR against CHIKV infection for the first time, encouraging its clinical validation toward future therapeutics. IMPORTANCE Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) is an arbovirus causing Chikungunya fever (CHIKF), leading to debilitating arthralgia and myalgia. The unavailability of licensed antivirals against CHIKV encourages extensive research to find a therapeutic cure. Retinoids, the derivatives of vitamin A, have been repurposed as antiviral agents against a broad range of viruses; however, their potency against alphaviruses remains unexplored. Accordingly, tretinoin (TR), also known as all-trans retinoic acid (ATRA), was validated for anti-CHIKV efficacy in this investigation. Significant perturbations of CHIKV titer, RNA, and protein levels were observed in the presence of TR following infection, and its antiviral effect was mediated through RAR-β. Moreover, the anti-CHIKV potential of TR was evaluated in the mouse model and primary human skeletal muscle myoblasts, indicating strong preclinical efficacy. Finally, this is the first study to report the antiviral property of TR against CHIKV infection using in vitro , in vivo , and ex vivo approaches, suggesting its repurposing potential.

papers.title: Protocol for Detecting and Sequencing Chikungunya Virus from Field-Collected Mosquitoes.
papers.abstract: Arboviral diseases represent a major public health challenge, especially in tropical regions where environmental conditions may favor the proliferation and spread of mosquito vectors. Thus, early and accurate detection of chikungunya virus (CHIKV) in mosquito populations can be a valuable tool for effective surveillance of circulating variants and for identifying new viral introductions. Given the challenges of detecting arboviruses in field-captured mosquitoes, we describe an integrated workflow for CHIKV molecular detection and whole-genome sequencing. This protocol includes mosquito homogenization using a bead-based mechanical disruptor, RNA extraction using TRIzol reagent with minor modifications, molecular screening using CHIKV-specific RT-qPCR, and whole-genome amplification followed by sequencing on Illumina platforms. Despite the protocol being optimized for individual mosquitoes, it results in high-quality RNA suitable for both entomological surveillance and genomic analysis. As this protocol allows recovery of complete CHIKV genomes from mosquito specimens, it can serve as a basis for genomic epidemiology studies, enabling monitoring of viral diversity and lineage dynamics, and facilitating early detection of emerging variants to support timely and targeted public health interventions in endemic and at-risk regions.

papers.title: Global patterns of genetic diversity and evolution in chikungunya virus E2 glycoprotein
papers.abstract: The E2 glycoprotein of chikungunya virus (CHIKV) mediates host-cell attachment and entry and contains key antigenic determinants targeted by host immune responses. Variation in E2 can influence host interaction, immune recognition, lineage diversification, and epidemic fitness, it represents a biologically relevant target for assessing evolutionary pressures and epidemic dynamics. In this study, we conducted a comprehensive analysis of E2 genetic diversity using a dataset of sequences collected across regions, hosts, and epidemic periods. Diversity indices, neutrality tests, and haplotypes network analysis were applied to characterize evolutionary pressures acting on E2 glycoprotein. To assess the influence of geography, host, and time on viral population structure, we performed spatial–temporal stratification and analysis to assess clustering patterns across lineages and regions using Fixation index test (Fst). Nucleotide diversity varied considerably across time, with the pre-expansion period (pre-2004) showing the highest diversity (Pi = 0.085), while more recent outbreak periods exhibited comparatively reduced diversity (Pi = 0.012). Neutrality tests revealed signatures of both purifying and positive selection across the three CKIKV E2 lineages (negatively statistically significant Tajima D, Fu and Li’s D, and Fu and Li’s F tests, p -values < 0.05) supported by codon‐based analyses showing pervasive purifying constraint across the E2 gene but recurrent diversifying signals at lineage‐specific sites, notably codon 146 in the West African lineage, codons 220, 245, 247, and 254 in the Asian lineage, and codons 54, 56, 102, 145, 163, 177, and 350 in the East/Central/South/African lineage. Population structure analyses using Fst indicated significant genetic differentiation between regional populations, reflecting restricted gene flow and localized evolutionary trajectories. Haplotype network analysis highlighted distinct clustering patterns shaped by geography and epidemic waves, reflecting the persistence of lineage-specific signatures across regions. At the same time, reduced connectivity among recent outbreak strains point to more discrete intercontinental movement events, likely driven by human-mediated vector dispersal or travel-associated introductions. Collectively, these findings underscore the spatiotemporal evolution of CHIKV E2 glycoprotein and its implications for viral adaptation and immune evasion.

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to investigate the genetic diversity and evolution of the E2 glycoprotein in chikungunya virus (CHIKV), focusing on its role in host-cell attachment, immune recognition, and lineage diversification.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study analyzed a dataset of sequences collected across different regions, hosts, and epidemic periods to examine the genetic structure of CHIKV E2 glycoprotein. Population structure analyses using Fst indicated significant genetic differentiation between regional populations, reflecting restricted gene flow and localized evolutionary trajectories.
analysis.methods: The study conducted a comprehensive analysis of E2 genetic diversity using a dataset of sequences collected across regions, hosts, and epidemic periods. To assess the influence of geography, host, and time on viral population structure, spatial–temporal stratification and analysis were performed using Fixation index test (Fst).
analysis.main_results: Nucleotide diversity varied considerably across time, with the pre-expansion period (pre-2004) showing the highest diversity (Pi = 0.085), while more recent outbreak periods exhibited comparatively reduced diversity (Pi = 0.012). Neutrality tests revealed signatures of both purifying and positive selection across the three CHIKV E2 lineages, supported by codon‐based analyses showing pervasive purifying constraint across the E2 gene but recurrent diversifying signals at lineage‐specific sites.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings highlight the spatiotemporal evolution of CHIKV E2 glycoprotein, revealing lineage-specific adaptive changes that may influence immune evasion and epidemic dynamics.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results provide insights into the evolutionary pressures shaping CHIKV E2 glycoprotein, which could inform surveillance strategies, vaccine development, and understanding of viral adaptation and immune evasion mechanisms.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its reliance on sequence data without direct experimental validation, and the evidence is moderate due to the absence of detailed statistical controls and potential biases in sequence sampling.

analysis.summary_en: This study explores the genetic diversity and evolution of the E2 glycoprotein in chikungunya virus (CHIKV), focusing on its role in host-cell attachment and immune recognition. Using a dataset of sequences collected across regions, hosts, and epidemic periods, the research applies diversity indices, neutrality tests, and haplotype network analysis to characterize evolutionary pressures. Results show that nucleotide diversity was highest in the pre-expansion period (Pi = 0.085) and lower in recent outbreaks (Pi = 0.012). Neutrality tests indicated both purifying and positive selection across CHIKV lineages, with lineage-specific diversifying signals observed at key codons. These findings highlight the spatiotemporal evolution of CHIKV E2 glycoprotein, offering insights into viral adaptation and immune evasion. The study's evidence is moderate due to its reliance on sequence data without direct experimental validation.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV)中E2糖蛋白的遗传多样性及进化,重点关注其在宿主细胞附着、免疫识别和谱系分化中的作用。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究分析了来自不同地区、宿主和流行病学时期的序列数据集,以研究CHIKV E2糖蛋白的遗传结构。利用Fst进行的种群结构分析表明,不同地区的种群之间存在显著的遗传分化,反映了基因流动受限和局部化的进化轨迹。
elements_zh.methods: 本研究使用来自不同地区、宿主和流行病学时期的序列数据集,对E2的遗传多样性进行了全面分析。为了评估地理、宿主和时间对病毒种群结构的影响,进行了时空分层分析,利用固定指数检验(Fst)进行评估。
elements_zh.main_results: 核苷酸多样性在不同时期存在显著差异,其中扩张前时期(2004年前)表现出最高的多样性(Pi = 0.085),而近期的暴发时期则显示出相对较低的多样性(Pi = 0.012)。中性检验显示,在三个CHIKV E2谱系中均存在正选择和纯化选择的信号,支持了基于密码子的分析结果,即在整个E2基因中普遍存在纯化约束,但在谱系特异性位点则出现了反复的多样化信号。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现突显了CHIKV E2糖蛋白的时空进化特性,揭示了可能影响免疫逃逸和流行病学动态的谱系特异性适应性变化。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果为理解塑造CHIKV E2糖蛋白的进化压力提供了见解,可能有助于制定监测策略、疫苗开发以及了解病毒适应性和免疫逃逸机制。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性在于其依赖于序列数据而没有直接的实验验证,且由于缺乏详细的统计控制和序列采样中的潜在偏差,证据强度中等。

papers.title_zh: 全球遗传多样性及进化在基孔肯雅病毒 E2糖蛋白中的模式
papers.source_body_en: The E2 glycoprotein of chikungunya virus (CHIKV) mediates host-cell attachment and entry and contains key antigenic determinants targeted by host immune responses. Variation in E2 can influence host interaction, immune recognition, lineage diversification, and epidemic fitness, it represents a biologically relevant target for assessing evolutionary pressures and epidemic dynamics. In this study, we conducted a comprehensive analysis of E2 genetic diversity using a dataset of sequences collected across regions, hosts, and epidemic periods. Diversity indices, neutrality tests, and haplotypes network analysis were applied to characterize evolutionary pressures acting on E2 glycoprotein. To assess the influence of geography, host, and time on viral population structure, we performed spatial–temporal stratification and analysis to assess clustering patterns across lineages and regions using Fixation index test (Fst). Nucleotide diversity varied considerably across time, with the pre-expansion period (pre-2004) showing the highest diversity (Pi = 0.085), while more recent outbreak periods exhibited comparatively reduced diversity (Pi = 0.012). Neutrality tests revealed signatures of both purifying and positive selection across the three CKIKV E2 lineages (negatively statistically significant Tajima D, Fu and Li’s D, and Fu and Li’s F tests, p -values < 0.05) supported by codon‐based analyses showing pervasive purifying constraint across the E2 gene but recurrent diversifying signals at lineage‐specific sites, notably codon 146 in the West African lineage, codons 220, 245, 247, and 254 in the Asian lineage, and codons 54, 56, 102, 145, 163, 177, and 350 in the East/Central/South/African lineage. Population structure analyses using Fst indicated significant genetic differentiation between regional populations, reflecting restricted gene flow and localized evolutionary trajectories. Haplotype network analysis highlighted distinct clustering patterns shaped by geography and epidemic waves, reflecting the persistence of lineage-specific signatures across regions. At the same time, reduced connectivity among recent outbreak strains point to more discrete intercontinental movement events, likely driven by human-mediated vector dispersal or travel-associated introductions. Collectively, these findings underscore the spatiotemporal evolution of CHIKV E2 glycoprotein and its implications for viral adaptation and immune evasion.

papers.title: Workflow for Long-Read Amplicon Sequencing of Chikungunya Virus Using Oxford Nanopore Technology.
papers.abstract: This protocol provides a comprehensive, step-by-step workflow for whole-genome sequencing of Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) using an amplicon-based strategy optimized for Oxford Nanopore Technologies (ONT) platforms. The procedure includes detailed instructions for sample handling, viral RNA extraction, quality control, cDNA synthesis, multiplex PCR amplification, library preparation, sequencing, and primary bioinformatic processing. The protocol is designed to maximize reproducibility across laboratories and is suitable for genomic surveillance applications, including outbreak investigation and molecular epidemiology, even when working with low-to-moderate viral loads.

papers.title: The C-terminal part of the Chikungunya virus nsP2 protein interacts with host proteins MK2 and MK3 to facilitate efficient infection
papers.abstract: Host-viral protein interactions play a crucial role in driving viral infection and pathogenesis. MK2 and MK3, serine/threonine protein kinases of the p38 MAPK family, have been implicated in Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) infection. This investigation aimed to elucidate the interaction between MK2/MK3 and the viral protein nsP2 and to explore its significance in CHIKV infection through in silico and in vitro approaches. This study demonstrated that nsP2 interacts with host kinases MK2 and MK3 during CHIKV infection. Notably, the C-terminal (CT) domain of nsP2 (nsP2-CT; amino acids [aa] 422-798) was found to be involved in this interaction. Furthermore, it was revealed that nsP2-CT interacts with MK2 only in the presence of CHIKV infection, while MK3 exhibits this interaction independently of CHIKV infection. Additionally, two sub-fragments of nsP2-CT, CT1 (aa 458-621) and CT2 (aa 603-798), were also found to interact with MK2. In contrast, MK3 did not interact with any of the nsP2-CT fragments. The importance of these interactions was further validated by assessing viral infection in the presence of MK2 or MK3 overexpression, with or without nsP2-CT. The findings suggest that overexpression and inhibition of MK2 or MK3 impair viral infection by reducing viral titers; however, the inhibition was rescued by cotransfection of MK2 with nsP2-CT. In conclusion, this study confirms that nsP2-CT interacts with host proteins MK2 and MK3 during CHIKV infection, and that these interactions appear to contribute to efficient CHIKV infection, which will help identify potential therapeutic targets to control CHIKV infection.

papers.title_zh: 基孔肯雅病毒 nsP2蛋白的C端部分与宿主蛋白MK2和MK3相互作用,促进高效感染
papers.source_body_en: Host-viral protein interactions play a crucial role in driving viral infection and pathogenesis. MK2 and MK3, serine/threonine protein kinases of the p38 MAPK family, have been implicated in Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) infection. This investigation aimed to elucidate the interaction between MK2/MK3 and the viral protein nsP2 and to explore its significance in CHIKV infection through in silico and in vitro approaches. This study demonstrated that nsP2 interacts with host kinases MK2 and MK3 during CHIKV infection. Notably, the C-terminal (CT) domain of nsP2 (nsP2-CT; amino acids [aa] 422-798) was found to be involved in this interaction. Furthermore, it was revealed that nsP2-CT interacts with MK2 only in the presence of CHIKV infection, while MK3 exhibits this interaction independently of CHIKV infection. Additionally, two sub-fragments of nsP2-CT, CT1 (aa 458-621) and CT2 (aa 603-798), were also found to interact with MK2. In contrast, MK3 did not interact with any of the nsP2-CT fragments. The importance of these interactions was further validated by assessing viral infection in the presence of MK2 or MK3 overexpression, with or without nsP2-CT. The findings suggest that overexpression and inhibition of MK2 or MK3 impair viral infection by reducing viral titers; however, the inhibition was rescued by cotransfection of MK2 with nsP2-CT. In conclusion, this study confirms that nsP2-CT interacts with host proteins MK2 and MK3 during CHIKV infection, and that these interactions appear to contribute to efficient CHIKV infection, which will help identify potential therapeutic targets to control CHIKV infection.
papers.abstract_zh: 宿主病毒蛋白相互作用在驱动病毒感染和发病机制中起着关键作用。MK2和MK3是p38 MAPK家族的丝氨酸/苏氨酸蛋白激酶,已被证实与基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV)感染相关。本研究旨在通过计算机模拟和体外方法阐明MK2/MK3与病毒蛋白nsP2之间的相互作用及其在CHIKV感染中的意义。本研究显示,在CHIKV感染过程中,nsP2与宿主激酶MK2和MK3发生相互作用。值得注意的是,nsP2的C端(CT)结构域(nsP2-CT;氨基酸[aa] 422-798)参与了这一相互作用。此外,研究还发现nsP2-CT仅在CHIKV感染存在的情况下与MK2相互作用,而MK3则可以在没有CHIKV感染的情况下与nsP2-CT相互作用。另外,nsP2-CT的两个亚片段CT1(aa 458-621)和CT2(aa 603-798)也被发现与MK2相互作用。相比之下,MK3并未与任何nsP2-CT片段发生相互作用。这些相互作用的重要性通过在MK2或MK3过表达的情况下评估病毒感染(有或无nsP2-CT)得到了进一步验证。研究结果表明,MK2或MK3的过表达和抑制会通过降低病毒滴度来损害病毒感染;然而,当MK2与nsP2-CT共转染时,这种抑制作用被逆转。总之,本研究证实,在CHIKV感染过程中,nsP2-CT与宿主蛋白MK2和MK3发生相互作用,这些相互作用似乎有助于高效的CHIKV感染,这将有助于识别控制CHIKV感染的潜在治疗靶点。

Qingre Huashi Touzhen Decoction (QHTD), the guideline-preferred first-line Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) regimen for CF, urgently warrants further study into its efficacy and underlying mechanisms. Methods A multicenter retrospective cohort study was conducted. Clinical data of CF patients diagnosed with acute-phase ShiYu HuaRe Syndrome (SYHRS) from August to October 2025 were collected according to strict inclusion and exclusion criteria. A total of 135 patients in the QHTD group (conventional supportive therapy + QHTD) and 255 patients in the control group (conventional supportive therapy alone) were initially screened. Following 1:1 propensity score matching, 130 patients were finally included in each group. Outcome measures included overall treatment response rate and TCM syndrome scores on Days 3 and 7, resolution rates and resolution times of primary symptoms (fever, arthralgia, and rash), incidence of adverse reactions, and the incidence of arthralgia sequelae at the 3-month follow-up. Mechanistic validation employed network pharmacology, molecular docking, and dynamics to quantify QHTD's components, targets, pathways, binding affinity, and stability. analysis.research_question_and_background: Chikungunya fever (CF) is a mosquito-borne viral disease causing acute febrile illness and debilitating chronic arthralgia. Qingre Huashi Touzhen Decoction (QHTD), the guideline-preferred first-line Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) regimen for CF, urgently warrants further study into its efficacy and underlying mechanisms.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A multicenter retrospective cohort study was conducted. Clinical data of CF patients diagnosed with acute-phase ShiYu HuaRe Syndrome (SYHRS) from August to October 2025 were collected according to strict inclusion and exclusion criteria. A total of 135 patients in the QHTD group (conventional supportive therapy + QHTD) and 255 patients in the control group (conventional supportive therapy alone) were initially screened.
analysis.methods: Methods included a multicenter retrospective cohort study. Following 1:1 propensity score matching, 130 patients were finally included in each group. Outcome measures included overall treatment response rate and TCM syndrome scores on Days 3 and 7, resolution rates and resolution times of primary symptoms (fever, arthralgia, and rash), incidence of adverse reactions, and the incidence of arthralgia sequelae at the 3-month follow-up.
analysis.main_results: The QHTD group exhibited statistically superior outcomes across all primary endpoints: significantly higher overall treatment response rate on Day 3, greater mean reductions in TCM syndrome scores on Days 3 and 7 (all P < 0.05), faster resolution rates and shorter resolution times for fever, arthralgia, and rash, and lower incidence of adverse reactions and arthralgia sequelae at the 3-month follow-up.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the findings as evidence of QHTD's effectiveness in improving clinical outcomes for CF patients. The study's novelty lies in its comprehensive evaluation of QHTD's efficacy and mechanisms in treating CF.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can cautiously inform the use of QHTD as a potential adjunct therapy for CF, particularly in improving treatment response rates and reducing symptom duration and sequelae.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is a retrospective cohort study, which may introduce bias and confounding factors. The evidence strength is moderate due to the study design and potential limitations in data collection and analysis.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the clinical efficacy and underlying mechanisms of Qingre Huashi Touzhen Decoction (QHTD) in treating chikungunya fever (CF). A multicenter retrospective cohort study was conducted on 130 patients in each of the QHTD and control groups, with outcomes measured on Days 3 and 7, and at 3-month follow-up. The QHTD group showed statistically superior results across all primary endpoints, including higher treatment response rates, greater reductions in TCM syndrome scores, faster symptom resolution, and lower incidence of adverse reactions and sequelae. The authors interpret these findings as evidence of QHTD's effectiveness in managing CF, highlighting its potential as an adjunct therapy. The study's significance lies in its contribution to understanding QHTD's role in CF treatment. However, the evidence strength is moderate due to the retrospective design and potential biases.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 基孔肯雅热(CF)是一种由蚊媒传播的病毒性疾病,可引起急性发热性疾病和致残性慢性关节痛。清热化湿透疹汤(QHTD)是CF指南推荐的一线传统中药(TCM)治疗方案,亟需进一步研究其疗效及潜在机制。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 进行了一项多中心回顾性队列研究研究。根据严格的纳入和排除标准,收集了2025年8月至10月期间诊断为急性期 ShiYu HuaRe 综合征(SYHRS)的CF患者的临床数据。最初筛选了135例QHTD组患者(常规支持治疗+QHTD)和255例对照组患者(仅常规支持治疗)。
elements_zh.methods: 方法包括一项多中心回顾性队列研究研究。经过1:1倾向评分匹配后,每组最终纳入130例患者。主要结局指标包括总体治疗反应率、第3天和第7天的中医证候评分、主要症状(发热、关节痛和皮疹)的缓解率和缓解时间、不良反应的发病率以及3个月随访时关节痛后遗症的发病率。
elements_zh.main_results: QHTD组在所有主要终点指标上均表现出统计学上的显著优势:第3天总体治疗反应率显著提高,第3天和第7天中医证候评分平均下降幅度更大(所有P < 0.05),发热、关节痛和皮疹的缓解率更高且缓解时间更短,3个月随访时不良反应和关节痛后遗症的发病率更低。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将研究结果解释为QHTD在改善CF患者临床结局方面的有效性。本研究的创新性在于其全面评估了QHTD在治疗CF中的疗效和机制。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果可以谨慎地支持将QHTD作为CF潜在辅助治疗方案的使用,特别是在提高治疗反应率和减少症状持续时间及后遗症方面。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究是一项回顾性队列研究研究,可能引入偏倚和混杂因素。由于研究设计和数据收集与分析的潜在局限性,证据强度中等。

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 基孔肯雅热(CF)是一种由蚊媒传播的病毒性疾病,可引起急性发热性疾病和致残性慢性关节痛。清热化湿透疹汤(QHTD)是CF指南推荐的一线传统中药(TCM)治疗方案,亟需进一步研究其疗效及潜在机制。方法 进行了一项多中心回顾性队列研究研究。根据严格的纳入和排除标准,收集了2025年8月至10月期间诊断为急性期 ShiYu HuaRe 综合征(SYHRS)的CF患者的临床数据。最初筛选了135例QHTD组患者(常规支持治疗+QHTD)和255例对照组患者(仅常规支持治疗)。经过1:1倾向评分匹配后,每组最终纳入130例患者。主要结局指标包括总体治疗反应率、第3天和第7天的中医证候评分、主要症状(发热、关节痛和皮疹)的缓解率和缓解时间、不良反应的发病率以及3个月随访时关节痛后遗症的发病率。机制验证采用网络药理学、分子对接和动力学方法,量化QHTD的成分、靶点、通路、结合亲和力和稳定性。结果 QHTD组在所有主要终点指标上均表现出统计学上的显著优势:第3天总体治疗反应率显著提高,第3天和第7天中医证候评分平均下降幅度更大(所有P < 0.05),发热、关节痛和皮疹的缓解率更高且缓解时间更短,3个月随访时不良反应和关节痛后遗症的发病率更低。解释与创新性 作者将研究结果解释为QHTD在改善CF患者临床结局方面的有效性。本研究的创新性在于其全面评估了QHTD在治疗CF中的疗效和机制。科学与公共卫生意义 研究结果可以谨慎地支持将QHTD作为CF潜在辅助治疗方案的使用,特别是在提高治疗反应率和减少症状持续时间及后遗症方面。局限性与证据强度 本研究是一项回顾性队列研究研究,可能引入偏倚和混杂因素。由于研究设计和数据收集与分析的潜在局限性,证据强度中等。

papers.title: Computational identification of potential inhibitors for chikungunya virus nsP2pro
papers.abstract: Abstract Chikungunya virus remains a crucial global health issue with no approved therapy available. In particular, the viral replication is associated with the non-structural protein 2 protease (nsP2pro). In this study, possible inhibitors for nsP2pro from the National Cancer Institute (NCI) database were screened via computational approaches. Molecular docking simulations were initially predicted top potential ligands. MD simulations were then performed to refine the ligand binding pose. During the equilibrium intervals, the ligands formed rigid contacts with the residues Asn476, Ala511, Tyr512, Tyr544 and Trp549 of nsP2pro. Moreover, five compounds probably prevent the biological activity of nsP2pro by increasing the distance of Cys478-Sγ–Nε-His548 and Ser482-Oγ–Nε-His548 pairs. Furthermore, perturbation simulations finally confirmed that NSC 319990, NSC 80731, NSC 80735, NSC 67436 and NSC 37553 compounds exhibited significantly stronger binding affinity, ranging from –9.70 ± 0.61 to –11.71 ± 1.25 kcal mol–1, than that of the available inhibitor RA-0002034, ΔGFEP = − 6.45 ± 0.32 kcal mol–1. papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 基孔肯雅病毒仍然是一个重要的全球健康问题,目前尚无批准的治疗方法。特别是,病毒复制与非结构蛋白2蛋白酶(nsP2pro)密切相关。本研究通过计算方法筛选了来自美国国家癌症研究所(NCI)数据库中可能的nsP2pro抑制剂。首先通过分子对接模拟预测了潜在的配体,随后通过分子动力学(MD)模拟优化了配体的结合构象。在平衡阶段,配体与nsP2pro的Asn476、Ala511、Tyr512、Tyr544和Trp549残基形成了刚性接触。此外,五种化合物可能通过增加Cys478-Sγ–Nε-His548和Ser482-Oγ–Nε-His548配对之间的距离来阻止nsP2pro的生物活性。进一步地,扰动模拟最终确认NSC 319990、NSC 80731、NSC 80735、NSC 67436和NSC 37553化合物表现出显著更强的结合亲和力,范围为–9.70 ± 0.61至–11.71 ± 1.25 kcal mol–1,相较于现有抑制剂RA-0002034(ΔGFEP = − 6.45 ± 0.32 kcal mol–1)具有更高的结合能力。此外,ΔGFEP与Cys478-Sγ–Nε-His548配对之间的强相关性表明,结合能力更强的配体对nsP2pro的生物活性抑制效果更好。总体而言,这些发现表明五种NCI化合物是进一步实验验证作为新型nsP2pro抑制剂的极具前景的候选者。

papers.title: Optimized Amplicon Strategy for Long-Read Sequencing of the Chikungunya Virus Genome.
papers.abstract: Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) is a positive-sense RNA alphavirus transmitted to humans primarily by Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus mosquitoes. Its global circulation and significant public health impact underscore the need to better understand the molecular mechanisms driving CHIKV pathogenesis and transmission. Although robust molecular biology methods exist for CHIKV genome sequencing, a major limitation for surveillance and research is the inability to determine whether two nucleotide variations co-occur within the same viral genome when they are separated beyond the span of typical short-read designs. Here, we describe an optimized approach for processing CHIKV RNA samples that generates large amplicons suitable for long-read nanopore sequencing. This protocol enables amplification of the complete CHIKV genome in only two or three amplicons and facilitates detection of co-occurring nucleotide variations across 4-7.5 kb within the same molecule, thereby simplifying sequencing workflows and improving resolution in studies of viral evolution.

papers.title_zh: 用于 基孔肯雅病毒 基因组 长读长测序的优化扩增子策略。
papers.source_body_en: Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) is a positive-sense RNA alphavirus transmitted to humans primarily by Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus mosquitoes. Its global circulation and significant public health impact underscore the need to better understand the molecular mechanisms driving CHIKV pathogenesis and transmission. Although robust molecular biology methods exist for CHIKV genome sequencing, a major limitation for surveillance and research is the inability to determine whether two nucleotide variations co-occur within the same viral genome when they are separated beyond the span of typical short-read designs. Here, we describe an optimized approach for processing CHIKV RNA samples that generates large amplicons suitable for long-read nanopore sequencing. This protocol enables amplification of the complete CHIKV genome in only two or three amplicons and facilitates detection of co-occurring nucleotide variations across 4-7.5 kb within the same molecule, thereby simplifying sequencing workflows and improving resolution in studies of viral evolution.

papers.title: Adaptive Spatial Regularization for Aedes-Borne Disease Risk Prediction: A Case Study of Chikungunya
papers.abstract: Abstract Chikungunya fever (CHIKF), caused by the chikungunya virus (CHIKV), is a widespread Aedes-borne disease whose range is expanding under climate change. Reliable risk prediction from presence-only surveillance data is essential for vector control but faces two obstacles: underreporting makes reported absence an unreliable label, and standard models treat neighboring grid cells as spatially independent. We propose ASR-XGBoost (Adaptive Spatial Regularization XGBoost), whose centerpiece embeds spatial dependence directly into the training objective: a gated penalty integrates 8-neighborhood mean soft labels with block-adaptive strength, constraining the predicted probability surface rather than adding sample coordinates. Ecologically stratified pseudo-absence sampling reduces label bias, while an anomaly-correction step (ASRAC) that extends ASR repairs spatially inconsistent cells. On a global CHIKF dataset, ASR-XGBoost achieves competitive discrimination (test AUC = 0.9334) with the best spatial generalization and calibration (AUC(CV) = 0.9187, Brier(CV) = 0.1234); ASRAC further improves spatial continuity (Moran's I = 0.8200) while preserving predictive performance. These components reduce label bias and keep spatial dependence explicit; they are also applicable to other Aedes-borne diseases, supporting reliable risk prediction in data-sparse regions for forward-looking surveillance planning.

papers.title_zh: 适应性空间正则化用于登革热等蚊媒疾病风险预测:基孔肯雅热案例研究
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Chikungunya fever (CHIKF), caused by the chikungunya virus (CHIKV), is a widespread Aedes-borne disease whose range is expanding under climate change. Reliable risk prediction from presence-only surveillance data is essential for vector control but faces two obstacles: underreporting makes reported absence an unreliable label, and standard models treat neighboring grid cells as spatially independent. We propose ASR-XGBoost (Adaptive Spatial Regularization XGBoost), whose centerpiece embeds spatial dependence directly into the training objective: a gated penalty integrates 8-neighborhood mean soft labels with block-adaptive strength, constraining the predicted probability surface rather than adding sample coordinates. Ecologically stratified pseudo-absence sampling reduces label bias, while an anomaly-correction step (ASRAC) that extends ASR repairs spatially inconsistent cells. On a global CHIKF dataset, ASR-XGBoost achieves competitive discrimination (test AUC = 0.9334) with the best spatial generalization and calibration (AUC(CV) = 0.9187, Brier(CV) = 0.1234); ASRAC further improves spatial continuity (Moran's I = 0.8200) while preserving predictive performance. These components reduce label bias and keep spatial dependence explicit; they are also applicable to other Aedes-borne diseases, supporting reliable risk prediction in data-sparse regions for forward-looking surveillance planning.
papers.abstract_zh: 基孔肯雅热(CHIKF)是由基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV)引起的一种广泛传播的蚊媒疾病,其传播范围正在气候变化背景下扩大。从仅存在数据(presence-only data)进行可靠的风险预测对于蚊媒疾病控制至关重要,但面临两个挑战:报告不足使得报告的缺失数据成为不可靠的标签,且标准模型将相邻网格单元视为空间独立。我们提出了一种名为ASR-XGBoost(适应性空间正则化XGBoost)的方法,其核心在于将空间依赖性直接嵌入到训练目标中:一种门控惩罚机制整合了8邻域均值软标签,并采用块自适应强度,从而约束预测概率面,而非添加样本坐标。生态分层的伪缺失数据抽样减少了标签偏差,而一种异常校正步骤(ASRAC)扩展了ASR方法,用于修复空间不一致的单元格。在一项全球基孔肯雅热(CHIKF)数据集上,ASR-XGBoost实现了具有最佳空间泛化和校准能力的竞争性判别能力(测试AUC = 0.9334;AUC(CV) = 0.9187,Brier(CV) = 0.1234);ASRAC进一步提高了空间连续性(Moran's I = 0.8200),同时保持了预测性能。这些组件减少了标签偏差并保持了空间依赖性的明确性;它们同样适用于其他蚊媒疾病,支持在数据稀疏地区进行可靠的风险预测,从而为前瞻性蚊媒疾病防控计划提供依据。

papers.title: Assessing the Vector Competence for Chikungunya Virus in Mosquitoes.
papers.abstract: Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) is a human pathogenic, mosquito-borne virus (arbovirus), which is causing epidemic outbreaks among human populations in Africa, Asia, Europe, and South- and Central America including the Caribbean. The development of novel approaches to prevent mosquito transmission of the virus in the field requires a detailed study of CHIKV interactions with its mosquito vectors in the laboratory. In this chapter, we describe how to prepare Aedes aegypti mosquitoes for the infection with freshly cultivated CHIKV. We also describe quantitative and qualitative viral detection assays in mosquitoes based on plaque assays and the amplification of saliva samples in cell culture.

papers.abstract_zh: 基孔肯雅病毒 (CHIKV) 是一种人类致病性蚊媒病毒(虫媒病毒),正在非洲、亚洲、欧洲、南美洲和中美洲(包括加勒比地区)人群中引起 暴发 流行。在现场开发预防蚊子 传播 病毒的新方法需要在实验室中详细研究 CHIKV 与其蚊子 媒介 的相互作用。在本章中,我们将介绍如何让埃及伊蚊做好感染新鲜培养的 CHIKV 的准备。我们还描述了基于噬菌斑测定和细胞培养中唾液样本扩增的蚊子的定量和定性病毒检测测定。

papers.title: Plaque Reduction Neutralization Test Against Chikungunya Virus Using Liver Homogenate.
papers.abstract: We adapted the plaque reduction neutralization test (PRNT) to detect chikungunya virus (CHIKV) neutralizing antibodies in liver homogenates instead of serum. This approach enables serological investigation using tissues collected from animal carcasses as nonhuman primate ones, during arbovirus surveillance, expanding opportunities for CHIKV monitoring and strengthening epidemiological surveillance efforts.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to develop a novel method for detecting chikungunya virus (CHIKV) neutralizing antibodies using liver homogenates, addressing the need for improved serological tools in arbovirus surveillance.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The research involved adapting the plaque reduction neutralization test (PRNT) to use liver homogenates as a medium for detecting CHIKV neutralizing antibodies, with the study conducted in a laboratory setting and focused on nonhuman primate tissues collected during arbovirus surveillance.
analysis.methods: The plaque reduction neutralization test (PRNT) was modified to utilize liver homogenates instead of serum, allowing for the detection of CHIKV neutralizing antibodies from animal carcasses during arbovirus surveillance.
analysis.main_results: The adapted PRNT method successfully detected CHIKV neutralizing antibodies in liver homogenates, demonstrating its feasibility for serological investigation using nonhuman primate tissues.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted this as a novel approach that expands opportunities for CHIKV monitoring and strengthens epidemiological surveillance efforts by utilizing alternative biological specimens.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: This method can inform improved surveillance strategies for CHIKV, particularly in scenarios where serum samples are not available, and may contribute to better understanding of CHIKV transmission and immunity in nonhuman primate populations.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to an abstract-only report, and the evidence is based on a single methodological adaptation without detailed statistical analysis or broader validation, resulting in moderate confidence in the findings.

analysis.summary_en: This study introduces an adapted plaque reduction neutralization test (PRNT) to detect chikungunya virus (CHIKV) neutralizing antibodies in liver homogenates, offering a new approach for serological investigation using tissues from animal carcasses during arbovirus surveillance. The method was developed to address limitations in traditional serum-based testing, particularly in nonhuman primate populations. The findings suggest that this technique can enhance CHIKV monitoring and strengthen epidemiological efforts. However, the study is based solely on an abstract, and the evidence is limited to a single methodological adaptation without detailed statistical validation, which restricts the confidence in the results. The approach may have implications for improving surveillance strategies in contexts where serum samples are not available, but further research is needed to validate its effectiveness and generalizability.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在开发一种使用肝匀浆检测 基孔肯雅病毒 (CHIKV) 中和抗体的新方法,解决虫媒病毒 监测 血清学工具改进的需求。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究涉及将斑块减少中和试验(PRNT)适应为使用肝组织匀浆作为检测基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV)中和抗体的介质,研究在实验室环境下进行,并聚焦于在蚊媒病毒监测期间收集的非人灵长类动物组织。
elements_zh.methods: 斑块减少中和试验(PRNT)被修改为使用肝组织匀浆而非血清,从而允许在蚊媒病毒监测期间从动物尸体中检测基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV)中和抗体。
elements_zh.main_results: 经过调整的PRNT方法成功在肝组织匀浆中检测到基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV)中和抗体,证明了其在使用非人灵长类动物组织进行血清学调查中的可行性。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者认为这是一种新颖的方法,扩大了基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV)监测的机会,并通过利用替代生物样本加强了蚊媒病毒监测的流行病学研究。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该方法可以为基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV)的蚊媒病毒监测策略提供信息,特别是在无法获得血清样本的情况下,可能有助于更好地理解基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV)的蚊媒病毒传播及其在非人灵长类动物种群中的免疫情况。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究仅限于摘要报告,证据基于单一的方法学调整,没有详细的统计分析或更广泛的验证,导致研究结果的置信度中等。

papers.title: MXRA8-dependent chikungunya virus infection in PDGFRα+ mesenchymal cells increases vascular permeability and facilitates hematogenous spread
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Alphaviruses are mosquito-transmitted pathogens in the Togaviridae family that cause severe arthritogenic or encephalitic disease in humans. Swelling of peripheral joints and soft tissues is a hallmark of arthritogenic alphavirus infection, although the mechanism by which tissue edema occurs is not well understood. The cell surface protein, matrix remodeling- associated protein 8 (MXRA8), is a cell entry receptor for several arthritogenic alphaviruses. Global loss of MXRA8 expression in mice abrogates foot swelling and reduces virus dissemination. Here, we demonstrate that specific ablation of MXRA8 from platelet-derived growth factor receptor alpha (PDGFRα) cells, including fibroblasts, phenocopies the foot swelling and dissemination deficits observed in chikungunya virus (CHIKV)-infected global MXRA8 knock-out mice. Edema in the foot requires CHIKV infection of PDGFRα + cells, which enhances both infection efficiency and permeability of endothelial cells. CHIKV-induced vascular leakage requires both MXRA8 expression and vascular endothelial growth factor signaling and contributes to dissemination by enabling virus access to the bloodstream. Collectively, our study establishes the role of MXRA8-dependent cell tropism in CHIKV dissemination and pathogenesis.

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to investigate the role of MXRA8-dependent cell tropism in the dissemination and pathogenesis of chikungunya virus (CHIKV). The background highlights that alphaviruses, including CHIKV, are mosquito-transmitted pathogens that cause severe arthritogenic or encephalitic disease in humans, with joint swelling and soft tissue edema being a hallmark of infection.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study used a global loss of MXRA8 expression in mice to observe the effects on foot swelling and virus dissemination. It also involved specific ablation of MXRA8 from PDGFRα+ cells, including fibroblasts, to replicate the observed deficits in CHIKV-infected mice.
analysis.methods: The researchers employed genetic ablation techniques to remove MXRA8 expression in mice and in PDGFRα+ cells. They assessed the resulting effects on vascular permeability and virus dissemination through observational and experimental methods.
analysis.main_results: Global loss of MXRA8 in mice abrogated foot swelling and reduced virus dissemination. Specific ablation of MXRA8 from PDGFRα+ cells phenocopied these deficits, indicating a critical role for MXRA8 in CHIKV pathogenesis.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings demonstrate that MXRA8-dependent cell tropism in PDGFRα+ cells is essential for CHIKV-induced vascular leakage and hematogenous spread, offering novel insights into the mechanisms of CHIKV dissemination.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results provide important information for understanding the pathogenesis of chikungunya virus and may inform future strategies for surveillance, diagnosis, and treatment of CHIKV infections.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is based on experimental models and does not include clinical data, which may limit its direct applicability to human infections. However, the evidence is strong and supported by multiple experimental findings.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the role of MXRA8-dependent cell tropism in chikungunya virus (CHIKV) dissemination and pathogenesis. The research focuses on how MXRA8 expression in PDGFRα+ cells, such as fibroblasts, contributes to vascular permeability and hematogenous spread. The findings show that global loss of MXRA8 in mice reduces foot swelling and virus dissemination, and that specific ablation of MXRA8 from PDGFRα+ cells phenocopies these effects. These results highlight the importance of MXRA8 in CHIKV-induced vascular leakage and suggest potential targets for intervention. The study is based on experimental models, which may limit its direct clinical relevance, but the evidence is robust and supports the novelty of the findings.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨MXRA8依赖的细胞嗜性在基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV)扩散和发病机制中的作用。背景指出,包括CHIKV在内的阿尔法病毒是蚊媒传播的病原体,可引起人类严重的关节炎或脑炎,关节肿胀和软组织水肿是感染的特征。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究使用小鼠中全球性MXRA8表达缺失来观察其对足部肿胀和病毒扩散的影响。同时,还涉及在PDGFRα+细胞(包括成纤维细胞)中特异性缺失MXRA8,以复制CHIKV感染小鼠中观察到的缺陷。
elements_zh.methods: 研究人员采用遗传缺失技术去除小鼠和PDGFRα+细胞中的MXRA8表达。他们通过观察和实验方法评估了由此产生的对血管通透性和病毒扩散的影响。
elements_zh.main_results: 小鼠中全球性MXRA8缺失可消除足部肿胀并减少病毒扩散。在PDGFRα+细胞中特异性缺失MXRA8可复制这些缺陷,表明MXRA8在CHIKV 发病机制中起关键作用。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,PDGFRα+细胞中MXRA8依赖的细胞嗜性对于CHIKV诱导的血管渗漏和血源性传播至关重要,为CHIKV扩散的机制提供了新的见解。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果为理解基孔肯雅病毒的发病机制提供了重要信息,并可能为未来CHIKV感染的监测、诊断和治疗策略提供参考。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究基于实验模型,未包括临床数据,这可能限制其对人类感染的直接适用性。然而,证据是强有力的,并得到了多项实验结果的支持。

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 阿尔法病毒是蚊媒传播的黄病毒科病原体,可引起人类严重的关节炎或脑炎。外周关节和软组织肿胀是关节炎型阿尔法病毒感染的特征,尽管组织水肿的发生机制尚不明确。细胞表面蛋白,基质重塑相关蛋白8(MXRA8),是多种关节炎型阿尔法病毒的细胞进入受体。在小鼠中,全球性MXRA8表达缺失可消除足部肿胀并减少病毒扩散。在此研究中,我们证明了在血小板衍生生长因子受体α(PDGFRα)细胞(包括成纤维细胞)中特异性缺失MXRA8可复制出在基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV)感染的全球MXRA8敲除小鼠中观察到的足部肿胀和扩散缺陷。足部水肿需要CHIKV感染PDGFRα+细胞,这会增强感染效率和内皮细胞的通透性。CHIKV诱导的血管渗漏需要MXRA8的表达和血管内皮生长因子信号传导,并通过使病毒能够进入血液来促进扩散。综上所述,我们的研究确立了MXRA8依赖的细胞嗜性在CHIKV扩散和发病机制中的作用。
papers.summary_zh: 摘要 阿尔法病毒是蚊媒传播的黄病毒科病原体,可引起人类严重的关节炎或脑炎。外周关节和软组织肿胀是关节炎型阿尔法病毒感染的特征,尽管组织水肿的发生机制尚不明确。细胞表面蛋白,基质重塑相关蛋白8(MXRA8),是多种关节炎型阿尔法病毒的细胞进入受体。在小鼠中,全球性MXRA8表达缺失可消除足部肿胀并减少病毒扩散。在此研究中,我们证明了在血小板衍生生长因子受体α(PDGFRα)细胞(包括成纤维细胞)中特异性缺失MXRA8可复制出在基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV)感染的全球MXRA8敲除小鼠中观察到的足部肿胀和扩散缺陷。足部水肿需要CHIKV感染PDGFRα+细胞,这会增强感染效率和内皮细胞的通透性。CHIKV诱导的血管渗漏需要MXRA8的表达和血管内皮生长因子信号传导,并通过使病毒能够进入血液来促进扩散。综上所述,我们的研究确立了MXRA8依赖的细胞嗜性在CHIKV扩散和发病机制中的作用。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨MXRA8依赖的细胞嗜性在基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV)扩散和发病机制中的作用。背景指出,包括CHIKV在内的阿尔法病毒是蚊媒传播的病原体,可引起人类严重的关节炎或脑炎,关节肿胀和软组织水肿是感染的特征。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究使用小鼠中全球性MXRA8表达缺失来观察其对足部肿胀和病毒扩散的影响。同时,还涉及在PDGFRα+细胞(包括成纤维细胞)中特异性缺失MXRA8,以复制CHIKV感染小鼠中观察到的缺陷。
analysis_zh.methods: 研究人员采用遗传缺失技术去除小鼠和PDGFRα+细胞中的MXRA8表达。他们通过观察和实验方法评估了由此产生的对血管通透性和病毒扩散的影响。
analysis_zh.main_results: 小鼠中全球性MXRA8缺失可消除足部肿胀并减少病毒扩散。在PDGFRα+细胞中特异性缺失MXRA8可复制这些缺陷,表明MXRA8在CHIKV 发病机制中起关键作用。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,PDGFRα+细胞中MXRA8依赖的细胞嗜性对于CHIKV诱导的血管渗漏和血源性传播至关重要,为CHIKV扩散的机制提供了新的见解。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果为理解基孔肯雅病毒的发病机制提供了重要信息,并可能为未来CHIKV感染的监测、诊断和治疗策略提供参考。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究基于实验模型,未包括临床数据,这可能限制其对人类感染的直接适用性。然而,证据是强有力的,并得到了多项实验结果的支持。

papers.title: Surface Plasmon Resonance-Based Analysis of Ligand Binding Kinetics in Chikungunya Virus Drug Discovery.
papers.abstract: Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) is an emerging arbovirus lacking widely effective antiviral therapies, highlighting the need to characterize molecular interactions essential for its replication and pathogenesis. Surface plasmon resonance (SPR) is a sensitive, label-free technique that enables real-time analysis of biomolecular interactions by detecting refractive index changes at a sensor surface. SPR provides precise kinetic and affinity measurements for protein-protein, protein-RNA, and protein-ligand interactions using minimal sample quantities and supporting high-throughput screening. In CHIKV research, it has been applied to evaluate antiviral compounds, antibodies, receptor binding, and viral protein complexes. This chapter outlines key methodological considerations, including ligand preparation, immobilization strategies, assay optimization, and kinetic analysis.

papers.title: RT-RPA-Assisted CRISPR/Cas12a-Based Isothermal Detection of Chikungunya Virus.
papers.abstract: Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) is transmitted through the bite of Aedes mosquitoes, specifically A. CHIKV belongs to the alphavirus with a positive-sense ssRNA genome of 11-12 kb size. The virus has been reported from various geographical regions across the globe. Chikungunya fever is an acute febrile illness, which, if left untreated, may develop into chronic arthralgia that may persist for several months or acute encephalitis syndrome. Therefore, early diagnosis of CHIKV is crucial to initiate prompt supportive treatment. Laboratory diagnosis of CHIKV typically relies on serological tests such as IgM antigen capture ELISA and molecular methods including RT-PCR or qRT-PCR. However, both these methods are not viable in peripheral settings. This chapter highlights recent advancements in molecular detection techniques for CHIKV, specifically isothermal detection methods that eliminate the requirement for complex instruments. The detection is facilitated by RT-RPA and CRISPR/Cas12a endonuclease. The assay offers advantages over existing methods such as rapid and early detection, and eliminates cross-over contamination, ultra-sensitivity, high specificity, and ease of result interpretation.

papers.title: Production of Viral Particles from a Chikungunya Virus Infectious Clone.
papers.abstract: Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) is a positive-sense single-stranded RNA virus, which poses challenges for its study and genetic manipulation. Because direct mutagenesis of viral RNA genomes is technically impractical, reverse genetics systems are essential tools for investigating viral biology. To enable such approaches, infectious clones containing a full-length cDNA copy of the viral genome are constructed. The cDNA is positioned under the control of a bacteriophage RNA polymerase promoter, allowing commercial RNA polymerases to use the linearized plasmid as a template for the in vitro transcription of full-length viral genomic RNA (gRNA). Importantly, positive-sense viral genomes serve as mRNAs for the translation of viral proteins in a cellular environment, meaning that these transcripts contain all the information required to initiate viral replication. Following transfection into permissive cultured cells, viral proteins are expressed, enabling genome replication and, ultimately, the recovery of infectious particles from the cell supernatant. Here, we describe a detailed procedure for generating CHIKV particles through plasmid linearization, in vitro transcription, and subsequent RNA transfection.

papers.title: Non-identifiability of autochthonous chikungunya risk from surveillance data, Japan, 2011–2025
papers.abstract: Japan notifies imported chikungunya but has never detected autochthonous chikungunya, although Aedes albopictus transmits both chikungunya and dengue and Japan experienced an autochthonous dengue outbreak in 2014. This absence is often read as reassuring. We reconstructed weekly, prefecture-level dengue, chikungunya, and Zika notifications from 1,357 national surveillance bulletins (1999–2026) and combined a temperature-suitability index with notification-based introduction proxies in a branching-process model with an explicit cluster-detection process. A descriptive temperature-suitability–notification overlap index was highest in metropolitan prefectures and in late summer; this geographic ordering was stable across prespecified proxy variants, population and per-capita proxies, and prefecture-specific seasonality, but was driven predominantly by the notification proxy, not temperature. Zero detected chikungunya clusters over approximately 14.9 surveillance-years placed a one-sided 95% upper bound of about 0.20/year on the detected-cluster rate; the data constrained only the product of introduction pressure and per-introduction detection probability, identifying neither. Chikungunya risk relative to dengue was therefore not identifiable from surveillance counts alone. Absolute probabilities and importation multipliers were calibrated to two events and are scenarios, not forecasts. The absence of detected autochthonous chikungunya does not, by itself, establish low underlying transmission risk when ascertainment is unknown; resolving this non-identification requires disease-specific diagnostic and case-level data.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the non-identifiability of autochthonous chikungunya risk in Japan using surveillance data. It highlights that the absence of detected cases does not confirm low transmission risk due to unknown ascertainment processes. By analyzing 1,357 national surveillance bulletins from 1999 to 2026, researchers combined a temperature-suitability index with notification-based introduction proxies in a branching-process model. The results showed a descriptive temperature-suitability–notification overlap index was highest in metropolitan prefectures and late summer, driven primarily by the notification proxy. The study concludes that surveillance data alone cannot identify chikungunya risk relative to dengue, underscoring the need for disease-specific diagnostic and case-level data. The findings caution against over-reliance on surveillance data for public health decisions, as the results are constrained by notification-based proxies and calibrated to two events, remaining scenarios rather than forecasts.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在利用监测数据评估日本本土基孔肯雅热风险,因为未检测到病例并不一定意味着基孔肯雅热风险较低,这可能由于未知的确认过程所致。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究分析了1999年至2026年间的全国监测通报,重点关注日本的基孔肯雅热通报,并在分支过程模型中结合了温度适宜性指数与基于通报的输入代理。
elements_zh.methods: 研究人员从1,357份全国监测通报中重建了每周、都道府县级别的登革热、基孔肯雅热和寨卡病毒通报,并在包含明确集群检测过程的分支过程模型中结合了温度适宜性指数。
elements_zh.main_results: 描述性温度适宜性–通报重叠指数在都市都道府县和夏季末期最高,显示出在代理变体、人口和人均代理以及都道府县特定季节性中的稳定地理排序,但主要由通报代理驱动。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 数据仅约束了输入压力与每输入事件检测概率的乘积,而无法识别其中任何一个因素,突显了仅凭监测计数无法识别基孔肯雅热相对于登革热的风险。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现提醒人们不要仅依赖监测数据来评估基孔肯雅热风险,并强调了需要疾病特异性诊断和病例层面数据以制定公共卫生策略的重要性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的结果受到基于通报代理的限制,且不构成预测,因为绝对概率和输入倍增因子被校准到两个事件,仍属于情景。

papers.abstract_zh: 日本报告了输入性基孔肯雅热病例,但从未检测到本土基孔肯雅热病例,尽管Aedes albopictus可传播基孔肯雅热和登革热,且日本在2014年曾发生本土登革热暴发暴发。这种缺失通常被解读为令人安心的信号。研究人员从1,357份全国监测通报(1999–2026年)中重建了每周、都道府县级别的登革热、基孔肯雅热和寨卡病毒通报,并在分支过程模型中结合了温度适宜性指数与基于通报的输入代理,同时明确纳入了集群检测过程。描述性温度适宜性–通报重叠指数在都市都道府县和夏季末期最高,这种地理排序在预设的代理变体、人口和人均代理以及都道府县特定的季节性中保持稳定,但主要由通报代理驱动,而非温度。在约14.9个监测年中未检测到任何基孔肯雅热集群,对检测到的集群率设定了单侧95%上限约为0.20/年;数据仅约束了输入压力与每输入事件检测概率的乘积,而无法识别其中任何一个因素。因此,仅凭监测计数无法识别基孔肯雅热相对于登革热的风险。绝对概率和输入倍增因子被校准到两个事件,它们是情景而非预测。当无法确定确认过程时,未检测到本土基孔肯雅热的存在本身并不能证明基孔肯雅热风险较低;解决这种不可识别性需要疾病特异性诊断和病例层面的数据。
